name: Motion Physio
description: Physiotherapy and sports rehab clinic site with an interactive draw-in body map of treatment areas and animated recovery-outcome rings.
features: SVG body figure whose skeleton lines draw in and highlight treatment zones on hover, focus or tap
Progress rings that fill and count up recovery stats on scroll
Priced treatment cards with a featured sports-rehab block
Four-step care path, specialist team, FAQ and appointment form
signature: Joint lines of an SVG figure draw in and light up coral treatment zones on hover/focus; outcome rings fill on scroll
